name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
how_to:
Setup

1. Adjust a bench to an incline angle, typically 30–45 degrees.
2. Sit on the bench and position your feet flat on the ground for stability.
3. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
4. Lie back on the bench with the dumbbells held above your chest, arms extended but elbows slightly bent.
Execution

1. Inhale as you slowly lower the dumbbells in a wide arc, keeping your elbows slightly bent to protect your joints.
2. Lower until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor, or you feel a comfortable stretch in your chest.
3. Exhale as you bring the dumbbells back to the starting position, following the same arc.
